old_three_level_hold.reason: The old test mixed pigment chemistry with visible reflectance. This new estimand uses a different two-level hierarchy entirely within biochemical composition.

sample_unit.duplicate_rule: within each normalized species binomial retain first source-table row in original Table_1 row order

fine_state.definition: exact 13-bit detected-compound presence pattern in frozen source-column order
fine_state.detection_rule: numeric concentration > 0 => 1; numeric 0 or blank source cell => 0; any other nonnumeric/nonblank token => HOLD_SCHEMA before AUC

coarse_state.rule: PRESENT iff at least one of the 13 frozen fine-state bits is 1; NONE iff all 13 are 0

common_frame.rule: resolve species representative and tree crosswalk first; then remove fine states represented by fewer than 5 retained species; use exactly the same tips for coarse and fine estimands

opportunity_gate.rule: fine_state_count > coarse_state_count on the frozen common frame

hidden_memory_test.pair_universe: unordered retained-tip pairs sharing the same coarse biochemical state
hidden_memory_test.null: permute fine-state labels within coarse groups, preserving fine-state counts and coarse membership
hidden_memory_test.primary_effect: observed conditional AUC minus permutation-null mean
hidden_memory_test.pass_rule: compression opportunity exists, observed effect > 0, and one-sided permutation P <= 0.05
hidden_memory_test.fail_rule: compression opportunity exists but pass rule is not met

promotion_role.outcome_if_pass: A new v0.9 science/promotion audit may be opened; current v0.3 is not automatically replaced.
promotion_role.outcome_if_fail: Do not claim prospective biochemical generalization from this system; current v0.3 remains current.

no_posthoc_rescue: do not alter the 13 compound columns after row opening
do not use Dominant Anthocyanin instead of the frozen exact composition
do not use visible Color/Color code/reflectance as the fine state
do not change rare-state minimum of 5
do not change common-frame minimum of 20
do not change tree after outcome opening
do not change P threshold or permutation scheme
